name: Rad Balek 1.2.2 — flood alerts from GDACS, longer crisis tracking
body:
**NEW: GDACS flood alerts (European Commission JRC)**
- An independent worldwide source now watches for major floods affecting Algeria
- Advance-notice orange alerts — useful for wilayas along large river basins
- Always capped at orange: official confirmation (ONM/Civil Protection) is still required before a red

**Better tracking of long crises**
- During a multi-day red crisis the app now reminds you of the vigilance for up to 72 hours (was 12)

**Wider press coverage**
- Le Soir d'Algérie and Echorouk join TSA and Ennahar — better coverage of the centre and south

**Reliability & privacy**
- Fires: moved to NOAA-20/21 satellites + MODIS ahead of the Suomi NPP end-of-life on November 1, 2026
- Per-wilaya weather risk scores work again
- Hardened feed parsing against malformed data
- Offline cache guarded against abnormally large payloads

Not an official government service. In an emergency, call Protection Civile: 14 or 1021.

APK: app-release.apk (universal, all devices).
